result.topic_en: Riemann examines whether the four previously found cases of a rotating fluid ellipsoid with constant principal axes are the only ones: from the differential equations he derives the conditions $(b-c)u(vw'-v'w)+(b+c)u'(v'w-vw')=0$ etc., shows that $\theta$ and $u',v',w'$ must be constant, and then distinguishes subcases where some of the quantities $u,v,w,u',v',w'$ vanish.

methods.what: Three conditions from differentiating the integral equations, for constant axes
Common value 2a' of three ratio expressions when no variable vanishes
Constancy relations from the first differential equations
Relation between pi, chi, varsigma and omega

items.quote: Die Untersuchung, ob diese vier Fälle die einzigen sind, in denen die Hauptaxen [-...-] während der Bewegung constant bleiben, führt auf eine [-...-] weitläufige Rechnung, welche wir nur kurz andeuten wollen, [-...-] da sie nur ein negatives Resultat liefert.
items.english: The investigation of whether these four cases are the only ones in which the principal axes remain constant during the motion leads to a lengthy calculation, which we only want to sketch briefly, since it yields only a negative result.

items.quote: Aus der Voraussetzung, dass $a,b,c$ constant sind, kann man zunächst leicht folgern, dass $\theta$ constant ist
items.english: From the assumption that a, b, c are constant one can easily first deduce that theta is constant.

items.quote: Es ergiebt sich aber leicht, dass {+dann+} die sechs letzten Differentialgleichungen $(\alpha)$ nicht erfüllt werden können
items.english: But it follows easily that then the last six differential equations (alpha) cannot be satisfied.
